SETTING-1.name: NO_SUCH_SETTING
SETTING-1.description: Raised where nothing in this stack reads a setting by the name given.

SETTING-2.name: A_SECRET
SETTING-2.description: Raised where the name given is a secret's, which this command never writes.

SETTING-3.name: TAKEN_ELSEWHERE
SETTING-3.description: Raised where the name given belongs to the other of the two commands that write settings.

SETTING-4.name: UNWRITABLE_VALUE
SETTING-4.description: Raised where a value cannot be written as the setting asked for.

SETTING-5.name: SETTINGS_MOVED
SETTING-5.description: Raised when a change answers an offer read against settings that have since moved.

SETTING-6.name: ALREADY_HOLDS
SETTING-6.description: Raised where the setting already holds what the change asks for.

SETTING-7.name: OUTSIDE_ITS_CHOICES
SETTING-7.description: Raised where a change would leave a setting holding a value outside its choices.

SETTING-9.name: OWNER_SET_UP
SETTING-9.description: Raised where `PLEX_LINK_MODE` would enter or leave `owner` for a request service already set up.
